notes.title: Update notes 23rd of October, 2021
notes.content:
Added: pg up and pg down to zoom.
Fixed: Removed out of place block on Boulders: 007
Fixed: Inverted mouse wheel zoom.

notes.title: Update notes 10th of October, 2021
notes.content:
Added: You can zoom with the scroll wheel.

Fixed: Back button got disconnected in the get levels menu.
Fixed: Restarting a level didn't reset the play time.
Fixed: Settings where overwritten by default values unless each settings tab was visited.

notes.title: Update notes 8th of October 2021
notes.content:
Fixed: Shortened level transition fade time.
Fixed: Some UI polish.
Fixed: Pressing Esc now brings you back to the main menu from credits, settings and so on.
Fixed: Pressing 'r' restarts the level.
Fixed: Keyboard for selecting a button in the pause menu and level complete now works.

notes.title: Update notes 6th October
notes.content:
Added: More music and replaced some sound effects
Fixed: Clicking save now saves all changes made, not only the current tab.
Fixed: Some UI polish.
Fixed: Time is now pausing when the pause menu is open.
Fixed: After closing the pause menu you can now continue playing without having to click the screen first.
Fixed: Pressing Escape now toggles the pause menu.

notes.title: Update notes 5th of October
notes.content:
Fixed: You can now press and hold movement keys to move the player blocks.
Fixed sfx bug when connecting to some blocks.
Fixed destroyer block being able to create a hole in the player set of blocks.
Fixed so all Farewell Games made levels are installed the first time you play the game.

notes.title: Update notes 2nd of October, 2021
notes.content:

Small bug fixes and polish.
